title: Setup GitHub Repo
testStrategy: Verify repository exists and is accessible.

title: Research, Analysis & Prerequisite Gathering
description: Analyze workspace, VILA repo, Hugging Face pages, identify components and dependencies. Based on old task02.md.
details: Performed deep dive into NVLabs/VILA GitHub repo, reviewed Hugging Face pages, identified necessary model components and dependencies. Created initial environment.yml.
testStrategy: Confirm environment.yml exists and key dependencies are listed.

title: Model Acquisition & Dataset Preparation
description: Acquire NVILA-15B model, prepare datasets (including NW & PI), verify environment setup. Based on old 03_model_acquisition_dataset_preparation.md.
details: Download NVILA-15B, verify components (LLM, tokenizer, vision tower, projector), set up directory structure. Process NW-test-camera-1 and PI-test-camera-1 datasets into VILA format. Install flash-attn, s2wrapper, VILA (editable), apply DeepSpeed patch. Validate model loading and dataset structure.
testStrategy: Model loads without error. Datasets are in correct format. Environment passes dependency checks.

title: Define Fine-tuning Strategy
description: Define hyperparameters, data splitting, training parameters, and evaluation metrics for fine-tuning on CCTV footage.
details: Determine learning rate, batch size, number of epochs. Decide on validation split strategy (e.g., 80/20 train/val). Choose appropriate evaluation metrics (e.g., perplexity, task-specific accuracy if applicable). Document chosen parameters.
testStrategy: A configuration file or document exists detailing the full fine-tuning strategy.

title: Implement Fine-tuning Script
description: Adapt or create a Python script using the VILA codebase to perform fine-tuning with the defined strategy. Ensure compatibility with local environment and dataset format.
details: Modify VILA's finetuning scripts (e.g., finetuning/finetune.py) or create a new one. Ensure script correctly loads the model, tokenizer, and datasets. Implement data loading/preprocessing. Integrate defined hyperparameters. Add logging for metrics.
testStrategy: Script runs without crashing, loads data, and starts a training loop (can be tested with minimal data/epochs initially).

title: Run Initial Fine-tuning (NW-test-camera-1)
description: Execute the fine-tuning script using the NW-test-camera-1 dataset. Monitor training progress and log results.
details: Run the implemented script with the NW-test-camera-1 data and the defined strategy. Ensure sufficient compute resources are available. Monitor training logs for loss reduction and metric improvements. Save checkpoints.
testStrategy: Training completes for the specified duration. Logs and model checkpoints are saved.

title: Evaluate Fine-tuned Model (NW-test-camera-1, Validation)
description: Evaluate the performance of the model fine-tuned on NW-test-camera-1. Use appropriate validation techniques (e.g., hold-out set, comparison to base model).
details: Use the validation split of NW-test-camera-1 (or a separate test set). Calculate defined evaluation metrics. Optionally, perform qualitative analysis by comparing model outputs to base model outputs on sample prompts/images/videos.
testStrategy: Evaluation metrics are calculated and reported. Comparison against base model (if performed) is documented.

title: Develop Production System Architecture
description: Design the high-level architecture for an autonomous system that ingests new data and triggers fine-tuning (even if implementation is deferred).
details: Diagram the components needed: data ingestion mechanism, storage, trigger for fine-tuning, compute resource allocation, model versioning, serving mechanism. Define interfaces between components.
testStrategy: An architecture diagram and description document exists.

title: End-to-End System Testing (PI-test-camera-1)
description: Perform end-to-end testing of the fine-tuning process using the PI-test-camera-1 dataset to simulate a different camera/scenario.
details: Repeat the fine-tuning (Task 6) and evaluation (Task 7) process using the PI-test-camera-1 dataset. Compare results to the NW-test-camera-1 run. Identify any dataset-specific issues or necessary adjustments.
testStrategy: Fine-tuning and evaluation complete successfully for PI-test-camera-1. Results are documented and compared to the first run.
